title: Contract decision: are rollcall status responded/missing arrays optional?
description:
Cross-implementation contract divergence on Rollcall Status documents (spec/12-apps.md 18.6.3): Rust RollcallStatus::from_cbor (rust/lichen-client/src/checkin.rs) REQUIRES both responded and missing arrays; the C codec (lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/checkin.c:1103-1143) treats them as OPTIONAL defaulting to empty.

## Decision: REQUIRED arrays (even when empty)

Rationale:
1. One representation, not two - 'missing' and 'empty array' mean the same thing, pick one
2. Parsers are simpler - no conditional 'if exists' handling
3. Explicit contracts catch bugs earlier - server forgetting to populate fails loud
4. Cost is trivial - empty CBOR array is 1 byte (0x80)

## Action
1. Fix C codec to REQUIRE both arrays (reject if absent)
2. Update checkin.h docs to match (remove 'optional' language)
3. Add test vector with empty arrays to pin the contract
4. Rust is already correct - no changes needed

## Files to modify
- lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/checkin.c:1103-1143
- lichen/include/lichen/checkin.h:407-424
- test/vectors/ (add empty-arrays vector)
notes: 2026-08-28: Human decision - require arrays, fix C. Rust behavior is correct.
close_reason: Dismissed: Decision made: require arrays, fix C
